title: Ab initio and density functional theory study of the mechanism of synthesis of the N5+ cation
authors: Xu W.-G., Li G.-L., Wang L.-J., Li S., Li Q.-S.

species.source_note: Table 1 / text p. ~304: 'The N5+ cation has C2v symmetry with bond lengths of R12=1.302, R24=1.111 A'

bond_params.description: V-shaped C2v cation (final product of the HN3 + N2F+ -> N5+ + HF mechanism studied in this paper); R24 assumed terminal bond, R12 assumed inner bond by analogy with N5+.pdf/N5-N6-abinitio.pdf conventions -- exact atom labeling per this paper's own numbering not fully disambiguated from text alone.

species.notes: DUPLICATE/cross-reference of the same N5+ C2v species independently reported in N5+.pdf (experimental X-ray, this same batch: 1.102-1.107/1.295-1.303) and N5-N6-abinitio.pdf (topology_only mention). This paper is primarily a reaction-mechanism study (many ion-molecule complex intermediates and transition states along the HN3+N2F+ pathway) -- those mechanistic intermediates/TS structures were NOT extracted here (out of scope: not stable characterized N5 isomers, just points along one specific reaction coordinate).
